All keeper-like functions are role-gated: USDxMarket settle/mint/redeem require MINT_/REDEEM_OPERATOR_ROLE, cancelOrder SETTLEMENT_MANAGER_ROLE (eth_call from fresh 0xA11ce..0001 reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount 0xe2517d3f); StakedUSDx fundRewards REWARD_MANAGER_ROLE, serviceRedemptions/serviceRedeemRequest REDEMPTION_SERVICER_ROLE (both revert 0xe2517d3f from fresh addr).
